evidence_basis: Published source theory. Source auditing and comparisons are not independent recalculation or experimental validation.

prior.summary: New to the reviewed candidate mechanism catalogue, source prediction already published; not first discovery.
prior.case_context: Exact Be4AlRe/AlBe4Re query found no primary experimental exact phase. Closest retrieved Be experimental study contains ReBe2 and WBe13, different compositions/prototypes; current object is an already published computed SG216 source state, new only to this reviewed catalogue.

sources.title: Sampling the materials space for conventional superconducting compounds
Primary source study: conventional superconducting compounds

prior.claim_boundary: Every listed state already has a published source prediction. Related compositions or phases are not experimental confirmation of this exact state. This dossier does not establish global novelty or an exhaustive literature search.

bottleneck.summary: Light Be framework with Re/Tc mass, chemistry and scalar-SOC approximation coupled; source gain is not a universal 5d or bandwidth effect. Fine residual force is 0.01375 eV/A, so fine-grid equilibrium and any SOC shift remain refinement uncertainties.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Source coarse force 6.32365997844544e-05 eV/Å, pressure -0.0 GPa; fine force 0.013753515124951335 eV/Å, pressure -0.134 GPa. Actual full stress, Γ interval, finite path and q observations are retained in the complete review; no whole-BZ/global-stability claim.
unknowns: Experimental superconductivity in this exact state
Direct support for approximately 300 K at ambient pressure

proposed_contribution.intervention: Re-for-Tc Be4Al role substitution. coupled chemical/site-role/volume/mass construction, not isolated geometry or inferred W/n
proposed_contribution.next_action: At the same source SG216 Be geometry, resolve saved orbital-resolved EPC and Re/Tc mode contributions. Favorable: the observed gain survives method-matched active modes; adverse: it reverses under independently justified integration/Coulomb treatment; ambiguous: mode/orbital association unavailable.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
